subject.title: Inject sibling agent list into session system prompt

question: Should OpenClaw expose sibling-agent identity, role/theme, and A2A permission topology to an agent, and if so should it be prompt-injected or available only through a gated discovery tool?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested data exposes operator topology and permission policy to model-visible context, so maintainers need to choose the safe product boundary before implementation.

options.title: Gate roster through agents_list
options.body: Expose only bounded metadata for agents already visible to the requester through `agents_list`, with explicit tests for A2A permission summaries and redaction/omission rules.

options.title: Inject prompt roster
options.body: Add a deterministic prompt section for allowed siblings, accepting the token and topology-exposure cost as product policy.

options.title: Reject core exposure
options.body: Keep sibling metadata out of core prompt/tool context and leave richer orchestration catalogs to external documentation or a plugin design.

recommendation.title: Gate roster through agents_list
recommendation.body: Expose only bounded metadata for agents already visible to the requester through `agents_list`, with explicit tests for A2A permission summaries and redaction/omission rules.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced `agents_list`, which is the narrowest existing owner boundary for this request.
